The DVMH Group also consists of Battery Park Veterinary Hospital, West Village Veterinary Hospital, and Seaport Animal Hospital, all conveniently located in downtown Manhattan. When we enter medical information into your pet's electronic medical record, it is immediately copied to each of our other hospital locations.
